{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Champagne silk chiffon midi dress, A-line silhouette, knee to mid-calf length, soft shimmering champagne (#F5E6CA), lightweight woven fabric.
Nude satin pointed-toe pumps, sleek narrow cut, ankle height, sheer nude with gold detailing (#D4AF37), smooth leather material.
Pearl drop earrings, teardrop shape, medium length, iridescent white (#FFFFF0), freshwater pearl and brass hardware.

This ensemble strikes the perfect balance between summer elegance and smart occasion-appropriate style for an outdoor ceremony followed by a restaurant reception in August. The shimmering champagne fabric catches the early evening light during the outdoor vows while remaining breathable for warm weather, ensuring you feel comfortable yet radiant throughout the day. Transitioning seamlessly to the restaurant setting, the nude pumps elongate your legs and ground the airy dress with sophistication, while the pearl earrings add a touch of refined detail that ensures you stand out as requested without overshadowing the bride."}
